{
  "implementation": "import math

def solve(case):
    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    n_rows = len(matrix)
    n_cols = len(matrix[0])
    weighted = [[matrix[i][j] * idf[j] for j in range(n_cols)] for i in range(n_rows)]
    epsilon = 1e-10
    degrees = []
    for i in range(n_rows):
        sq = sum(weighted[i][j]**2 for j in range(n_cols))
        degrees.append(max(sq, epsilon))
    sqrt_deg = [math.sqrt(d) for d in degrees]
    v_scaled = [vector[i] / sqrt_deg[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    tmp = [0.0] * n_cols
    for j in range(n_cols):
        s = 0.0
        for i in range(n_rows):
            s += weighted[i][j] * v_scaled[i]
        tmp[j] = s
    w = [0.0] * n_rows
    for i in range(n_rows):
        s = 0.0
        for j in range(n_cols):
            s += weighted[i][j] * tmp[j]
        w[i] = s
    result = [w[i] / sqrt_deg[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    degree_rounded = [round(d, 6) for d in degrees]
    result_rounded = [round(r, 6) for r in result]
    return {"degree": degree_rounded, "result": result_rounded}"
}
